Florida Man Allegedly Bags $776 of Candy in Two Trips. Judge Sets Bail at $100,000

Police say the Circle K manager spotted him the next day at a Wawa. He has 51 prior convictions.

Gainesville police say a 56-year-old man emptied boxes of candy into a bag at a Circle K on North Main Street on Nov. 23 and again on Nov. 24, walking out without paying for about $776 worth. The store manager found him at a nearby Wawa on Nov. 25, and police arrested him on a grand theft charge. A judge set his bail at $100,000, citing a record of 51 prior convictions.
